$comment: yggdrasil providers (PROVIDER-WAVE 10-28) — opencode's `provider` block + `fallback`. Copy to ~/.config/yggdrasil/providers.json (or point YGG_PROVIDERS at it); the root re-reads it on change. The env provider `yggdrasil` (YGG_UPSTREAM_*) stays in the catalog unless an entry here takes its id. Keys: {env:NAME} or {file:path} — never the key itself in a file you might share.
